## Appearance

Blake has lank, tow-colored hair and green eyes. He is also described as having a big mouth.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## Personality

Blake is an individual who approaches matters with a serious disposition. Unlike others of a more frivolous nature, he maintains a thoughtful and earnest demeanor.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)_

## Traits

- takes things seriously  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)</sub>

## History

[Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake was a theological student who tried for a long time to avoid entering the ministry before taking charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church for the summer. During his time at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), he stayed as a guest at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse and met [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) ultimately earned Philippa's deep admiration and romantic affection after delivering a remarkably moving sermon at his church.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023), [v3 ch.Christine P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002), +24 more_
